title: A new Lectio
question: Choose the design to carry into your Firefox extension. These use illustrative timetable content; your real Lectio data stays intact.

options.label: Campus
options.thesis: An evergreen navigation rail and a warm, readable weekly workspace.
options.viewport: Week schedule in the center, deadlines to the right, student tasks in the sidebar.
options.risk: A full sidebar needs care on small laptops.

raised.raise: A consistent time scale makes days directly comparable.
Every section has a deliberate place in the navigation hierarchy.
Aligned times make lesson changes easy to scan.

options.label: Timetable
options.thesis: A spacious blue and white planner centered on the school week.
options.viewport: A wide five-day schedule, with deadlines below and compact navigation.

options.label: Compact
options.thesis: A dense utility grid makes schedule, deadlines and messages visible together.
options.viewport: A narrow rail beside a timetable and tightly aligned task and message lists.
options.case: Excellent information coverage; needs more concentration to scan.

canonCard.label: Classic workspace
canonCard.thesis: A neutral white student portal with familiar gray navigation.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, page title, central schedule and a compact task list.
canonCard.risk: A conventional design with little individual character.
